milestone: Milestone M2 & M3 Conformal v2 (Honest Mondrian LAC & Ablated Cascade)
protocol_note: T2 PASC cascade claim officially dropped; T2 keyword penalty was monotonic, making max(nc1, nc2) degenerate.

mondrian_lac_conformal.temperature_fit_regime: Fit on disjoint 126-query calibration split per fold (grid-search NLL)
mondrian_lac_conformal.dataset_limitation_finding: On this easy public benchmark (Gemini embeddings), fixed top-1 already achieves 95.6% coverage at set size 1.00. Conformal prediction yields no candidate reduction here. The domain where conformal sets buy efficiency is when top-1 is weak (MiniLM at 74.7% / v2 at 32.5%), where LAC delivers ~92.5% coverage at mean size 2.07 vs size 5.0 for fixed-k.

cascade_ablation.finding: Degenerate. Monotonic penalty causes max(nc1, nc2) = nc2 on every query.
cascade_ablation.recommendation: Cascade dropped. Single-stage Mondrian LAC is the mathematically rigorous protocol.

score_margin_heuristic.label: Score-Margin Heuristic (top - 0.05)
score_margin_heuristic.note: Fixed score margin threshold, not learned BoR.
